description.value: Abbotsford Super Market is an Asian-focused supermarket in the Chilliwack area offering basic groceries for touring cyclists. As a standard supermarket, it provides resupply for food and supplies. Limited additional amenity details are available due to website inaccessibility.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 34m; rack (5 spaces) at 51m. Total: 8 spaces.
